notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Temporary Halloween update. Exploding pumpkins are spawned at random throughout the world with GOLD or HP inside!


The event will last until the 6th of November!

notes.title: Update (5): Character acceleration, Spirit consuming skull
notes.notes:
Major changes:

- Added player acceleration (PC/ PS4)
(This helps to provide more precision control at slower speeds)
- Added life consuming skull underground
(Rewards player with gold for every 3 souls consumed by the skull)


Minor changes:

- Improved base layer tiles for walls
- Splash screen animation speed fix
- New underground audio fix
- Added tiki torches to underground levels for atmosphere

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
The following early feedback items bugs have been released:

- PS4/ Xbox controller support fix
- Alligator snap jump range changed to 32 pixels
- Weapon switch issues resolved
- Tiki torches added to provide clear indication of agro loss
- Invulnerable frames colour changed to red from white (Thanks for early feedback [b]Fant0m of Arg0s[/b])
